verdict.rationale: JumpCloud exposes a RESTful API (docs-4) that is clearly versioned: its spec is published at an /api/2.0/ path (docs-25). Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines or version lifecycle guarantees, and probes of standard OpenAPI paths all returned 404 (probe-3). missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, explicit versioning/lifecycle documentation beyond the v2.0 path, independent corroboration of API version stability.
